# Brain_Dynamics_Learning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for training neural systems to replicate the temporal evolution of brain activity using port-Hamiltonian constraints. Enables in-network neuromorphic hardware to emulate biologically realistic dynamics, improving efficiency and adaptability in edge computing.
